messages:
incident-bot: Pager: latency alert on dedicated pool 'orion-dedicated' (p95 > 2s). Auto-created channel and paging oncall.

kevin-oncall: ack — joining. Pulling pool map and host telemetry.

kevin-oncall: host orion-07 shows sustained task backlog (~540). GPU memory 86%, CPU 92%.

rachel-sre: seeing rapid KV invalidations tied to tenant `zephyr-corp` — spike in prefix-clear ops. Correlating with increased cache miss rate.

sara-devops: starting temporary request diversion to graceful fallback (orion-lite) on orion-03/04 to relieve pressure.

kevin-oncall: diversion live, latency on routed hosts down. Backlog on orion-07 still rising.

rachel-sre: I recommend soft-isolate + rate-limit for zephyr-corp to avoid full eviction. Running investigative queries now.

kevin-oncall: please paste the exact commands so CS/legal can audit actions.

rachel-sre:
```
# set tenant rate limit to 15 rps
redwoodctl tenant set-qos --tenant zephyr-corp --rps 15
# move tenant to isolation host pool
redwoodctl tenant migrate --tenant zephyr-corp --target-pool zephyr-isol-01
```

sara-devops: applied QoS and migration, connection drain started. Confirming active sessions on orion-07 decreasing.

kevin-oncall: backlog down to ~70. p95 trending to 420ms. Good stabilization.

lee-cs: ping — I’ve notified Zephyr's account team and engineering contact. They reported some 500s in their front-end; asked whether a rollback could help.

mohit-eng: avoid model rollback; that could lose cache/serving state. Isolation + fallback is safer.

harper-legal: note — any eviction or forced isolation could have contract/SLA implications. Need impacted window and affected tenancy list for credits.

rachel-sre: preliminary timeline: spike started ~1817779830, mitigation actions started 1817779935, stabilized by 1817780050. Rough impact ~3 minutes of elevated latency for co-located tenants.

console-bot: snapshot saved: orion-07 logs @ 1817779902 -> high invalidation rate 980/s for tenant zephyr-corp.

lee-cs: drafting customer-facing note to Zephyr. Suggest we propose a remedial credit offer; will confirm amount with finance.

kevin-oncall: internal RCA notes:
- probable cause: application-level burst of cache invalidation requests from zephyr-corp leading to cache churn and CPU/GPU scheduling pressure on orion-07
- mitigation: QoS rate-limit, tenant migration to isolated host, partial traffic routing to fallback variant
- impact: increased p95 for pool users ~1817779830–1817780050, no data lost, errors surfaced as transient 502/503s for Zephyr app
- follow-ups: add automated tenant-health triggers, tenant-metrics to console, include eviction guidance in runbook, CS+legal billing assessment

mohit-eng: I’ll prototype an adaptive tenant QoS controller (heuristic: invalidation rate + queue depth => dynamic throttle). Will aim for a design doc in 48h, PR in 5d.

ops-lead: assign owners: adaptive QoS -> mohit-eng, tenant metrics in console -> rachel-sre, runbook updates -> sara-devops, customer comm & credit ops -> lee-cs + finance.

harper-legal: when you have exact impacted minutes and list of customers, loop legal before sending formal credit language.

lee-cs: noted. Tentative customer note: "Hi Zephyr — We observed a short period of elevated latency affecting some of your requests due to a high volume of cache invalidation activity associated with your account. We applied rate-limiting and isolated your traffic which restored service. Estimated impact window: ~3 minutes. We will share a full RCA within 3 business days and propose a usage credit; finance will follow up on details." Holding for legal wording adjustments.

sara-devops: created follow-up tickets: PROD-1287 (adaptive QoS), PROD-1288 (tenant metrics in console), RUNBOOK-202 (eviction/playbook).

kevin-oncall: handing off to sara-devops at 1817780600. All stable; monitor for 30m.

sara-devops: taking handoff. I’ll keep an eye on orion-07 for flapping and post any regressions here.

ops-lead: schedule exec sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to review root cause and customer impact. Invite CS/legal/eng.

lee-cs: will schedule and confirm with Zephyr for a short post-incident call.

incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigations applied and service stabilized. Incident escalated to post-incident review.

kevin-oncall: final: saved logs and timelines in incident ticket. No further errors reported by Zephyr; closing live mitigation.

lee-cs: will send customer-friendly note once finance/legal approve credit language. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
